user.title: Add Arr server
user.description: Choose Radarr for movies or Sonarr for series. Each one is a separate entry.

connection.title: Connect to {app_name}
connection.description: Enter the {app_name} URL and API key. The server must be {app_name} 4.0 or newer.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {app_name}
reauth_confirm.description: {app_name} rejected the API key. Enter a new key for this {app_name} server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.old_version: The server must be version 4.0 or newer.
error.wrong_app: That URL is a different Arr app than the one you chose.
